name: com.fyber.ads.ofw.OfferWallActivity
description: Fyber OfferWall Edge and FairBid display an in-app offer wall with advertiser offers. It opens when the app launches the offer wall; disabling it also makes rewards tied to those offers unavailable.
disableEffect: The in-app Fyber offer wall and rewards tied to its offers will be unavailable; ordinary app features continue.
